description: Proposes changing land use from urban to rural commercial industrial.
Removes Grasswood Road site from future urban growth plan.
This application is for land in the RM of Corman Park.

chips.text: Councillor Dubois questioned risks of approving the change outside the concept plan.
Grasswood Ventures and Major Land Corp are the applicants.
Applicant's planner explained delays and RM of Corman Park's support.
Administration will identify replacement lands for urban commercial/industrial designation.
